name: Model of Unity
oracle_text:
Whenever players finish voting, you and each opponent who voted for a choice you voted for may scry 2.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
blocked_sentences: Whenever players finish voting, you and each opponent who voted for a choice you voted for may scry 2.

needs.what: a vote mechanic (701.38) that records each player's votes per vote, plus a 'players_finish_voting' trigger event fired when any vote completes, binding the vote record so the effect can select 'you and each opponent who voted for a choice you voted for' (a player filter reading shared vote choices) and have each of them may-scry 2
needs.why_existing_wont_do: There is no vote op in op_options and no voting event among trigger_events; choose_player/choose_mode are single-chooser decisions that produce no vote record, so neither the trigger nor the 'voted for a choice you voted for' player filter can be expressed. scry exists, but nothing selects which players scry
